params.command: $p=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId=74344" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if(-not $p){Write-Output 'ALREADY_STOPPED'; exit 0}; if($p.Name -ne 'powershell.exe' -or $p.CommandLine -notlike '*SESSION_STARTED_FOR_STOP_TEST*' -or $p.CommandLine -notlike '*UNEXPECTED_NATURAL_COMPLETION*'){Write-Error 'PID identity mismatch; refusing cleanup'; exit 41}; taskkill /PID 74344 /T /F | Out-String | Write-Output; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500; $q=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId=74344" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if($q){Write-Error 'PID still alive after taskkill'; exit 42}; Write-Output 'ORPHAN_SESSION_STOPPED_VERIFIED'; exit 0
